question: Can the Autel manual explain why every return-to-home attempt failed in the EVO Max 4N ASRS report?

intake.focus: RTH failure reasons in EVO Max 4N ASRS report
intake.reason: Assess whether the Autel EVO Max 4N manual explains why every return-to-home attempt failed, as discussed in an ASRS report.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance claims to reestablish control link or discontinue flight after loss of control link. The Autel EVO Max 4N manual claims RTH may be triggered and may continue reconnect attempts during signal loss, and that control returns if the link is restored within 10 seconds, with auto RTH if set to signal loss, and that restoration during RTH can allow the process to continue. Incident reports (unverified accounts) state that after takeoff control was completely lost and all Return To Home attempts failed. Gap: manuals describe potential reconnection during signal loss while incident reports and guidance imply RTH failure once link is lost; there is no explicit, verifiable timing or conditions for RTH failure after loss of control link.

claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft. If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

conditions: connection restored during RTH triggered by signal loss

claims.text: After takeoff, the ASRS reporter says, 'Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS,' and the platform continued to fly away from me.
claims.quote: Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS.

claims.quote: All attempts of Return To Home features failed.

C001.rationale: The cited passage explicitly states to try to reestablish the control link and, if it cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

C002.rationale: The cited passage explicitly states to discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.

C003.rationale: The cited passage includes guidance to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft during a loss of control link, i.e., it covers attempting to reestablish the link as described.

C004.rationale: The cited passage states that if the C2 link is lost for more than 10 seconds, the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.

C005.rationale: The cited passage states that if the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.

C006.rationale: The cited passage states that during automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.

C007.rationale: The cited manual states that if Signal Loss Action is set to Auto RTH, the drone will trigger RTH after the Autel Enterprise App displays the warning message: Aircraft disconnected.

C008.rationale: The cited passage states that if the connection is restored during RTH triggered by signal loss, the drone will continue to complete the RTH process.

C009.rationale: The cited passage states 'Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS' and 'Platform continued to fly away from me,' which matches the claim text post-takeoff and loss of control with the platform moving away.

C010.rationale: The cited passage states 'All attempts of Return To Home features failed,' which implies that Return To Home was attempted and that the RTH features failed.
